For your account security, we maintain a: For your account security, we maintain a rolling log of your last 5 sign-ins (timestamp, IP address, device type, and approximate country/city) so you can audit access and detect unauthorized logins. This sign-in history is automatically purged after 90 days.
We store short-link slugs, destination U: We store short-link slugs, destination URLs, and optional link protection passwords. Click analytics record the time, country and city, network provider, device and browser type, and the referring site. We keep a keyed hash of each visitor's IP address, never the address itself, plus a daily visitor hash that changes every day at 00:00 UTC, so a visitor cannot be followed from one day to the next. Link creators never see visitor IP addresses.
We store bio page layout blocks, links,: We store bio page layout blocks, links, text, and user-uploaded media (avatars, banners). A bio page owner can add a tracking pixel (Google Analytics, Meta or TikTok). The page owner chooses to add it and is responsible for it; HOP only provides the platform. The pixel loads only after the visitor agrees. When it loads, the visitor's browser sends data to that service under its own privacy policy. HOP does not receive or process that data.

PDFs are compressed, but their document properties are kept, so remove personal details from a PDF before you upload it.

Encrypted notes (the default) and their: Encrypted notes (the default) and their attachments are encrypted in your browser with AES-GCM before anything is sent over the network. An encrypted note can be read only by people who have the full link, including the part after #. Share the link only with the people you want to read it.
